comparison.objective: Insert two brake pads and swing a caliper closed, not tune axis cushioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Part alignment/insertion and hinged closure versus recessed fastener manipulation, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and iterative impact observation.
comparison.success_condition: Both pads installed and caliper closed; no spec versions or numeric fit/damage rubric are available. Candidate requires two bounded-energy cycles plus lock-drift verification.
comparison.reason: Brake assembly tests insertion and closure, not adjustable damping or post-lock dynamic performance.
